title: TSUNAH FOUNDATION 慈林教育基金會
content_html: Tsunah Foundation is a U.S. IRS-registered nonprofit organization based in Laguna Niguel, California. The foundation supports scholars and students engaged in study, research, and publications related to Taiwan’s arts, culture, education, history, and political and social movements. It works to establish and assist nonprofit institutions that advance understanding of Taiwan, and runs programs aimed at younger generations of Taiwanese Americans. The foundation also promotes peace, freedom, and democracy in Taiwan.
